{"assumptions": ["SG90 wave-axis modeled as linear DC motor + gearbox around mid-stroke, linearized friction and no saturation", "Wave-axis is shoulder/elbow pan servo output angle; second servo holds pose during wave", "Arm + bracket inertia reflected to servo output lumped as first-order time constant 0.12 s", "Proximity trigger, Arduino sampling and OLED face do not affect arm dynamics and are not modeled", "USB 5V supply assumed stiff; servo internal potentiometer loop treated as part of motor plant for outer Arduino PID design"],
  "controller": {"N": 80.0, "Q": [], "R": 1.0, "kd": 0.8, "ki": 10.0, "kp": 8.0, "type": "pid"},
  "controllerRationale": "PID on wave-joint angle for ~10 rad/s bandwidth. PD kp=8, kd=0.8 places dominant poles near zeta~0.9, wn~10 rad/s for <15% overshoot and <1s settling. ki=10 removes friction / gravity offset with minimal windup. N=80 rad/s (~8x bandwidth) filters Arduino/PWM noise.",
  "domain": "electromechanical",
  "equations": ["tau_m domega/dt + omega = Km * V", "dtheta/dt = omega"],
  "input": {"name": "servo drive voltage", "unit": "V"},
  "output": {"name": "arm wave angle", "unit": "rad"},
  "params": [{"name": "motor+gear static gain", "symbol": "Km", "unit": "rad/s/V", "value": 1.6}, {"name": "mechanical time constant", "symbol": "tau_m", "unit": "s", "value": 0.12}, {"name": "arm link length", "symbol": "L_arm", "unit": "m", "value": 0.08}, {"name": "reflected output inertia", "symbol": "J_eff", "unit": "kg*m2", "value": 0.00035}],
  "plant": {"A": [], "B": [], "C": [], "delay": 0.0, "den": [0.12, 1.0, 0.0], "kind": "tf", "num": [1.6], "stateNames": []},
  "rig": {"kind": "arm", "signal": "angle"},
  "sim": {"disturbanceMagnitude": 0.0, "disturbanceTime": -1.0, "ref": 0.6, "tEnd": 2.5},
  "specs": {"maxOvershootPct": 15.0, "maxSettlingTime": 1.0, "maxSsErrorPct": 2.0, "uMax": 5.0, "uMin": -5.0},
  "summary": "Desktop buddy with 2-servo pan-tilt arm that plays a fixed waving motion when a person is within 1m. Model is the wave-axis SG90 servo angle driven by Arduino voltage command.",
  "title": "Desktop Waving Buddy"}
